title: Azariah, Zechariah, Shallum, Menahem, Pekahiah, Pekah, and Jotham

questions.question: What was another name for King Azariah of Judah?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 15:13, 30, 32, 2 Chronicles 26:1. Often referred to as Uzziah.

questions.question: What happened to Azariah (Uzziah) because he did not remove the high places (and tried to burn incense)?
options: The Lord struck him with leprosy
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord struck him with leprosy
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 15:5 (ESV): "And the LORD struck the king, so that he was a leper to the day of his death..."

questions.question: Who governed the house while Azariah was a leper?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 15:5 (ESV): "...and Jotham the king's son was over the household, governing the people of the land."

questions.question: How many months did Zechariah reign over Israel?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 15:8 (ESV): "...Zechariah the son of Jeroboam... reigned six months."

questions.question: Who conspired against Zechariah and killed him?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 15:10 (ESV): "Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him and struck him down..."

questions.question: How long did Shallum reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 15:13 (ESV): "...and he reigned one month in Samaria."

questions.question: Who killed Shallum?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 15:14 (ESV): "Then Menahem... went up from Tirzah and came to Samaria, and he struck down Shallum..."

questions.question: What did Menahem do to the pregnant women of Tiphsah?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 15:16 (ESV): "...therefore he struck it down. All the pregnant women in it he ripped open."

questions.question: Who came against the land during Menahem's reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 15:19 (ESV): "Pul the king of Assyria came against the land..."

questions.question: How did Menahem pay Pul?
options: He exacted money from the wealthy men of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: He exacted money from the wealthy men of Israel
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 15:20 (ESV): "Menahem exacted the money from Israel, that is, from all the wealthy men..."

questions.question: Who killed Pekahiah son of Menahem?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 15:25 (ESV): "And Pekah... his captain, conspired against him and struck him down..."

questions.question: During the days of Pekah, who captured many cities and carried the people captive to Assyria?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 15:29 (ESV): "In the days of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria came and captured... and he carried the people captive to Assyria."

questions.question: Who killed Pekah?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 15:30 (ESV): "Then Hoshea... made a conspiracy against Pekah... and struck him down..."

questions.question: How long did Azariah reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 15:2 (ESV): "...and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem."

questions.question: What did Jotham build?
options: The upper gate of the house of the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: The upper gate of the house of the LORD
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 15:35 (ESV): "He built the upper gate of the house of the LORD."

key_verse_text: Pul the king of Assyria came against the land, and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, that he might help him to confirm his royal power. (ESV)
